hellofresh.provider_link_label: Trouble with your subscription? See how to cancel HelloFresh
hellofresh.meta_description: Official HelloFresh FAQ and Terms steps to cancel or pause a subscription, plus where to find cancellation in your account.
synonym_headings: How to cancel HelloFresh on the app
hellofresh.lede: HelloFresh publishes cancellation through your logged-in account: the FAQ sends you to the on-site cancellation flow, and the Terms describe Account Settings and Customer Care contact options. Pause or cancel before the cutoff shown on My Menu / stated in the FAQ.

steps.text: Log in to your account.
steps.source_label: HelloFresh FAQ — How do I cancel my subscription?

steps.text: To cancel, use the cancellation flow linked from the FAQ (hellofresh.com/cancellation/) and follow all prompts on the screen to finalize.
steps.source_label: HelloFresh FAQ — How do I cancel my subscription?

steps.text: Log on to your account, click your name in the upper right-hand corner, then click Account Settings. On the Plan settings page, scroll down and click Manage (under Subscription Status section). Follow the prompt(s) for your cancellation.
steps.source_label: HelloFresh Terms — Section 10.3 Cancellation Procedures

steps.text: You may also cancel by contacting Customer Care at hellofresh.com/contact-us, stating that you wish to terminate your Subscription, along with your full name and registered email address (see HelloFresh Terms for contact options).
steps.source_label: HelloFresh Terms — Section 10.3 Cancellation Procedures

append_sections.heading: How to pause HelloFresh before you cancel

steps.text: Log in to your account, click on My Menu, select the delivery day of the week you'd like to skip, then click Edit Delivery, and when the banner appears, click Skip This Week.
steps.source_label: HelloFresh FAQ — How do I cancel my subscription? (skip-a-week steps)

steps.text: Log on to your Account page on the Site or App, select a particular week (by clicking on the delivery day highlighted) and then click on the Pause Week button.
steps.source_label: HelloFresh Terms — Section 10.4 Pausing Your Order

timing_conditions.text: Just be sure to pause/cancel by 11:59 pm PST 5 days prior to your next scheduled delivery so we can alert our suppliers.
timing_conditions.source_label: HelloFresh FAQ — How do I cancel my subscription?

timing_conditions.text: You will not be charged for any week in which your order is paused. This action cannot be taken for any scheduled order which has already locked, pursuant to Section 10.2.
timing_conditions.source_label: HelloFresh Terms — Section 10.4 Pausing Your Order

timing_conditions.text: Just be sure to pause/cancel by 11:59 pm PST 5 days prior to your next scheduled delivery so we can alert our suppliers.
timing_conditions.source_label: HelloFresh FAQ — How do I cancel my subscription?

timing_conditions.text: If you wish to cancel your Account subscription and/or cancel or change an order, you must do so before the day and time listed on the My Menu page.
Your plan is weekly, but you can easily skip a week, pause, or cancel your account at any time. Just make sure you do so before your weekly cutoff to stop your next order.

app_notes.text: HelloFresh’s published FAQ for canceling a subscription does not list separate tap-by-tap steps for the mobile app. The FAQ cancellation answer points logged-in customers to the on-site cancellation flow. For account-level cancellation steps, use the Account Settings path in HelloFresh Terms section 10.3 while signed in (browser or in-app web view).
app_notes.source_label: HelloFresh FAQ — How do I cancel my subscription? (no dedicated app-only steps found)

factor.provider_link_label: Trouble with your subscription? See how to cancel Factor meals
factor.meta_description: Official Factor Terms and FAQ language on canceling a meal subscription online or via Customer Care.
synonym_headings: How do I cancel Factor meals
factor.lede: Factor’s Terms tell you to cancel from your online account (Account Settings → End Meal Subscription) or by contacting Customer Care; checkout terms state you can cancel online from your account menu before the weekly deadline.

steps.text: Log on to your account. Click on your name in the upper right-hand corner, then click Account Settings. On the Plan settings page, scroll down and click End Meal Subscription (under Status section). Follow the prompt(s) for your cancellation.
steps.source_label: Factor Terms — cancellation via account (Section 5.2 / account steps)

steps.text: You may cancel your subscription online from your account menu.
steps.source_label: Factor FAQ / checkout terms excerpt on factor75.com/faq

steps.text: You may also cancel your account by contacting Customer Care at factor75.com/contact, stating that you wish to terminate your Subscription, along with your full name and registered email address.
steps.source_label: Factor Terms — Customer Care cancellation

timing_conditions.text: You can change your menu, skip a delivery, or cancel your plan without incurring further charges at any time before 11:59 p.m. PST 5 days prior to your next scheduled delivery.
timing_conditions.source_label: Factor FAQ — checkout / subscription terms excerpt

timing_conditions.text: Your plan is flexible. For future deliveries, you can change, skip, or cancel anytime before the weekly deadline.
If you cancel, you may use your subscription until the end of your then-current subscription week; your subscription will not be renewed after your then-current week expires.

homechef.provider_link_label: Trouble with your subscription? See how to cancel Home Chef
homechef.meta_description: Steps from Home Chef’s official Help Center article on pausing/canceling a subscription, including web and mobile app paths.
homechef.lede: Home Chef’s Help Center says you cancel by pausing your subscription in Account Settings (web or app) and you must reach the confirmation screen and confirmation email for the cancellation to be complete.

steps.text: Log in, click Account in the upper right corner of your dashboard, and click on the Account Settings tab. The option to pause your subscription can be found on the bottom of the navigation tabs on the left.
steps.source_label: Home Chef Help Center

steps.text: If you're using the mobile app, click Account on the bottom right, select My Settings, and then select Pause My Account at the bottom.
steps.source_label: Home Chef Help Center

steps.text: You'll be asked to share your reason for pausing. Please note that your cancellation is not complete until you reach the cancellation confirmation screen and receive a confirmation email.
steps.source_label: Home Chef Help Center

timing_conditions.text: Be sure to cancel your subscription before Friday at 12 PM CST the week preceding your next delivery, as we're unable to cancel orders that have finalized, processed or shipped.
When you sign up with Home Chef, your first order is scheduled automatically. Cancelling your subscription will not cancel your first order or an order that's already been processed.

everyplate.provider_link_label: Trouble with your subscription? See how to cancel EveryPlate
everyplate.meta_description: Official EveryPlate FAQ and Terms on subscription cancellation timing and account steps.
everyplate.lede: EveryPlate’s FAQ states you can cancel before your weekly cutoff; the Terms publish the Account Settings → Manage cancellation clicks and Customer Care contact options.

steps.text: Log on to your Account. Click on your name in the upper right-hand corner, then click Account Settings. Scroll down on the Plan settings page and click Manage (under Subscription Status section). Follow the prompt(s) for your cancellation.
steps.source_label: EveryPlate Terms — Section 10.3 Cancellation Procedures

steps.text: You may also cancel your Account by contacting EveryPlate Customer Care at everyplate.com/contact or (973) 210-4915, stating that you wish to cancel your Subscription, along with your full name and registered email address.
steps.source_label: EveryPlate Terms — Section 10.3 Cancellation Procedures

timing_conditions.text: You can cancel your subscription at any time before your weekly cutoff (5 days before delivery). If you cancel after the cutoff, you may still be charged and your box may still be delivered, since it has already been prepared.
timing_conditions.source_label: EveryPlate FAQ — How do I cancel my subscription?

timing_conditions.text: All changes—such as skipping, updating meals, changing plan settings, or cancelling—must be made 5 days before your delivery by 11:59 PM ET.
timing_conditions.source_label: EveryPlate FAQ — What is the weekly cutoff time?

timing_conditions.text: No, you can cancel your plan at any time. Just make sure you do so before your weekly cutoff to stop your next order.

hungryroot.provider_link_label: Trouble with your subscription? See how to cancel Hungryroot
hungryroot.meta_description: Official Hungryroot Help Center steps to cancel before your shopping window closes.
hungryroot.lede: Hungryroot’s Help Center says you can cancel before your shopping window closes using the linked cancellation flow, and you should receive a confirmation email.

steps.text: To cancel before your shopping window closes, follow the link on Hungryroot’s cancellation page (hungryroot.com/cancel/) to cancel your subscription.
steps.source_label: Hungryroot Help Center — How do I cancel my subscription?

steps.text: You'll get a confirmation email.
steps.source_label: Hungryroot Help Center

timing_conditions.text: If you just need a break, you can pause for up to 8 weeks instead of canceling (see Hungryroot’s pause link on the same Help Center article).
New customer? Contact us via text at 855-222-5704 before your shopping window closes.

cookunity.provider_link_label: Trouble with your subscription? See how to cancel CookUnity
cookunity.meta_description: Official CookUnity Help Center steps to cancel from Settings on web or in the app.
cookunity.lede: CookUnity’s Help Center publishes Settings-based cancellation on web and Account Settings in the app; confirm with the confirmation email.

steps.text: Log in to your CookUnity account and go to your Home Page. Click your Account icon, select Settings, scroll to Cancel Subscription, and click Cancel Subscription to open the cancellation flow.
steps.source_label: CookUnity Help Center — Cancel From Settings (Website)

steps.text: Select a reason, check the box confirming you agree with the subscription cancellation, and click Cancel my subscription to confirm.
steps.source_label: CookUnity Help Center — Cancel From Settings (Website)

steps.text: Open the CookUnity app, tap Account, tap Account Settings, scroll down and tap Cancel Subscription (this step may open a browser window), then select a reason, confirm the checkbox, and tap Cancel my subscription.
steps.source_label: CookUnity Help Center — Cancel From the App/Mobile Experience

timing_conditions.text: Canceling your subscription stops future weeks, but it doesn't automatically cancel orders that were already processed/billed.

You may cancel or modify a subscription at any time online by managing your account in the app, at CookUnity.com, or by contacting CookUnity through the channels listed on their Help Center. CookUnity has a strict cutoff for modifications, four to six days before your delivery day at noon.

blueapron.provider_link_label: Trouble with your subscription? See how to cancel Blue Apron
blueapron.meta_description: Blue Apron Terms Cancellation Policy: online via Autoship or Blue Apron+ pages, or Customer Support.
blueapron.lede: Blue Apron’s Terms say you may cancel Blue Apron subscriptions online following the “How do I cancel…” instructions on the Autoship or Blue Apron+ information pages, or by contacting Customer Support.

steps.text: You may cancel any of your Blue Apron subscriptions online at any time by following the instructions under the heading “How do I cancel…” in the FAQs on the Autoship information page or the Blue Apron+ information page.
steps.source_label: Blue Apron Terms — Cancellation Policy (Section 4.2)

steps.text: You may also cancel by contacting Customer Support as linked from Blue Apron’s Terms Cancellation Policy section.
steps.source_label: Blue Apron Terms — Cancellation Policy

timing_conditions.text: To avoid being charged for the next monthly or annual period, you must cancel your Blue Apron+ subscription prior to your scheduled billing date.

Any Autoship order(s) identified as “Processing” or “Shipped” on your Upcoming page cannot be cancelled; you will be responsible for all charges incurred with respect to those orders prior to cancellation of your Autoship subscription.

greenchef.provider_link_label: Trouble with your subscription? See how to cancel Green Chef
greenchef.meta_description: Official Green Chef Terms section 10.3 account cancellation steps and timing on My Menu.
greenchef.lede: Green Chef’s Terms section 10.3 describes canceling from Account Settings → Manage before the deadline on My Menu, or via Customer Care contact options on Green Chef’s site.

steps.text: Log on to your Account. Click on your name in the upper right-hand corner, then click Account Settings. Scroll down on the Plan settings page and click Manage (under Subscription Status section). Follow the prompt(s) for your cancellation.
steps.source_label: Green Chef Terms — Section 10.3 Cancellation Procedures

steps.text: You may also cancel your Account by contacting Green Chef Customer Care using the contact options on Green Chef’s official site, stating that you wish to cancel your Subscription, along with your full name and registered email address.
steps.source_label: Green Chef Terms — Section 10.3 Cancellation Procedures

timing_conditions.text: If you wish to cancel your Account subscription and/or cancel or change an order, you must do so before the day and time listed on the My Menu page (for example, five days prior to your next scheduled delivery for a Tuesday delivery).
timing_conditions.source_label: Green Chef Terms — Section 10.3 Cancellation Procedures

timing_conditions.text: If you do so after the time listed for your delivery day, you will be charged and receive your Meal Box for that week, and the cancellation will take effect for the following Delivery Week.
timing_conditions.source_label: Green Chef Terms — Section 10.3 Cancellation Procedures
